privileged_info_for_vlm: Verified Classifications: 1. Diethyl ether: PEROXIDE FORMER (Oxidizes readily in air to form unstable peroxides); 2. Tetrahydrofuran: PEROXIDE FORMER (Subject to peroxidation in the air); 3. Acetone: NOT A PEROXIDE FORMER; 4. Diisopropyl ether: PEROXIDE FORMER (Form explosive peroxide in storage); 5. Methanol: NOT A PEROXIDE FORMER; 6. Isopropylbenzene: PEROXIDE FORMER (Forms peroxides when exposed to air); 7. Toluene: NOT A PEROXIDE FORMER; 8. Acetic acid: NOT A PEROXIDE FORMER. The report must be at ~/Desktop/peroxide_audit_report.txt and follow the specified header and note format.
